Overview

Cagayan de Oro is a city in Misamis Oriental with a population of 728,000. The City of Golden Friendship, a major urban center in Mindanao known for whitewater rafting and economic growth. Housing is more affordable than the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 7b growing zone supports Mild — wide variety of vegetables, many fruit trees. The population skews young, with a median age of 25.0.
